channels.name: Petition to the County Assembly
channels.how: Petition in writing (handwritten, printed or typed) in English or Kiswahili, addressed to the county assembly, in the form set out in the Schedule to the Act. It must state whether the matter was raised with a relevant body and the response, and whether it is pending before any court; end with a clear prayer; carry each petitioner's name, address, ID number and signature or thumb impression; have no annexes. Submit to the Clerk of the County Assembly (or have an MCA present it with the Speaker's consent). The Clerk reviews it within 7 days and forwards it to the Speaker; a committee considers it under the Standing Orders and responds by a report tabled in the Assembly; the petitioner is notified in writing within 14 days of the decision. (Petition to County Assemblies (Procedure) Act 2020, ss.3-5.)

channels.name: County Budget and Economic Forum (CBEF)
channels.how: Established under PFM Act s.137: the Governor (chair), CEC members, and an equal number of non-public-officer representatives nominated by organisations of professionals, business, labour, women, persons with disabilities, the elderly and faith-based groups. It is consulted on county plans, the CFSP, the CBROP, and budgeting and economic matters. No official Nyamira CBEF membership list or contact was found. Nyamira's Circular No 1 2025/2026 puts CBEF non-state actors on the macro and sector working groups and schedules CBEF consultations (12 Feb, 22 Apr, 25 Jun 2026). CBROP 2025 reports that the planned induction of 21 CBEF members was 'Not done'.
